import re
with open("confluence_pages.txt") as f:
    text = f.read()

sections = text.split("==================== PAGE ")
print(sections[0])
for s in sections[1:]:
    lines = s.split("\n", 1)
    header = lines[0]
    body = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ""
    clean = re.sub(r'</(p|h1|h2|h3|h4|li|tr|div)>', '\n', body)
    clean = re.sub(r'<(td|th)[^>]*>', ' | ', clean)
    clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', clean)
    import html
    clean = html.unescape(clean)
    print("=== PAGE " + header)
    print(clean[:4000])
